description: Drives or reads a pin of a device: a level, a PWM duty or frequency, a mode, a voltage.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled: a setting is sent when it changes, an action once on each rising enable, a reading on every pass.

variants.description: Drives a pin high or low. A wired level wins over the one in the body.
Flips the level of a pin once on each rising enable.

activation.text: Flips the pin once each time the block is enabled.

variants.description: Reads the level of a pin.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled.

variants.description: Sets the PWM duty of a pin (0 to 4095 on a 12-bit device). The device refuses it unless the pin is in PWM mode.
Sets the PWM frequency of a pin; a device with one frequency for all its pins ignores the pin.
Configures what a pin does: input, output, PWM, ADC or DAC.
Puts a pin back in its power-on state once on each rising enable.

activation.text: Resets the pin once each time the block is enabled.

variants.description: Reads the voltage of an analog pin, in millivolts. The device refuses it unless the pin is in ADC mode.

activation.text: Reads on every pass while enabled.

variants.description: Drives an analog output pin to a voltage, in millivolts. The device refuses it unless the pin is in DAC mode.
